Differential Privacy Budget Accountant

Source: R/dp-federated-stats.R
dp_budget_accountant.Rd

Tracks cumulative (epsilon, delta) privacy budget expenditure across federated queries and aborts with dicomtk_fl_dp_budget_exceeded_error whenever a query would exceed the configured privacy ceiling.

Public fields

max_epsilon

Maximum allowed cumulative epsilon.

max_delta

Maximum allowed cumulative delta.

spent_epsilon

Cumulative epsilon spent so far.

spent_delta

Cumulative delta spent so far.
